source_title: All The Free Games You Can Claim In October 2026 - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Updated October 30, 2026, by Mark Sammut: The new Epic Games Store free game is available, and Hexologic is free on Steam. Kiborg and Trash Goblin have also been added to Amazon Prime Gaming.
Looking for a free game ? Well, October 2026 should meet your needs, and not only from one platform: Steam , Epic Games Store, Amazon Prime Gaming / Amazon Luna , IndieGala , etc. are handing out titles. While most of these freebies are indies that might not have much name recognition, free triple-A games are not unheard of either; heck, you can pick up Doom 2016 if you have a Prime subscription.
Console users cannot rely on claiming free games, but they can at least look forward to PlayStation Plus and Xbox Game Pass ' monthly arrivals. In October, both subscription services announced big new games, including Mafia: The Old Country for PS5 users and Gears of War: E-Day for Xbox players. Don't miss out on any freebie.
Please note that the section below with the links updates more frequently than the rest of the article, and it will continue to update even after October starts.
Giveaway End Date: October 31, 2026 @ 9 AM PT; 12 PM EST; 5 PM CEST
Steam gives out free games mostly at random, so it can be difficult to predict when one will be made available. Anyway, Hexologic is currently free, and it's a highly regarded puzzle game.
Giveaway End Date: November 5, 2026 @ 8 AM PT; 11 AM EST; 5 PM CEST
Epic Games Store Page: Sorry We're Closed
Probably the most famous giveaways in PC gaming, the Epic Games Store's weekly free games are simply reliable. Every Thursday at 8 AM PT or 11 AM EST, you can log on and add a title or two to your library for free. Most giveaways are indie titles a couple of years old, but they tend to be a bit more well-known than most of Steam's freebies.
Sorry We're Closed is a horror game that flips between fixed third-person action and first-person shooting, along with boasting a pretty cool art style. Great freebie for Halloween.
Giveaway End Date: November 2, 2026 @ 9 AM PT; 12 PM EST; 6 PM CEST
Well, that's quite a title. GetHigh.EXE is meant to be taken literally, as it is a platformer that simply challenges you to complete jumps with precision. Pretty standard stuff, although it comes with a fairly unique art style and gameplay style tailor-made for speedrunning. Well worth a try if you are looking for something to play that can both test your might and also provide you with a relaxing way to spend a bit of time.
Giveaway End Date: October 27, 2026 @ 1 PM PT; 4 PM EST; 10 PM CEST
Another Epic Games Store freebie. Terrascape is a strategy survival game where you build your way through the galaxy.
Amazon Luna / Prime Gaming (Requires Amazon Prime Membership)
Free Games For GOG, Epic Games Store, and Amazon Games
Although it's far less well-known than Epic or Steam, Amazon Prime Gaming (aka Amazon Luna ) arguably delivers October's best free-games lineup, and it's hardly the first month this has been the case . Technically, these titles aren't free; you need an Amazon Prime subscription to claim them. However, almost nobody gets Amazon Prime just for these giveaways, so the games might as well be free.
Spread across multiple platforms like GOG and even the Epic Games Store, you can add Doom, Vampire: The Masquerade - Swansong , FNAF: Into the Pit , and Zoria: Age of Shattering to your collection, and that's far from a complete lineup. Amazon typically adds freebies a couple of times per month, so October 2026's selection should evolve over the coming weeks.
Once you claim a game through Amazon Luna, it is yours – no Amazon Prime or Amazon Luna subscription required to play.
The listed dates are when the giveaways end.
Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
Alienware Arena 30th Anniversary Battle Pass
Collect Points To Claim Free Games (Inc. Deathloop, The Evil Within, Oblivion Remastered, And More)
Now for something a little bit different. Alienware Arena rewards subscribers with ARP (Alienware Reward Points) for visiting the site, and points increase if you maintain a daily streak. You can then redeem those points for a wide range of items, including DLC or even full games. At any given time, the platform offers a few Steam game giveaways; for instance, Cronos: The New Dawn is currently available for 500 points.
Throughout October, Alienware Arena is celebrating Alienware's 30th anniversary by issuing a Battle Pass. Once you create a (free) account and start the (free) Battle Pass, you gradually accumulate points and reach milestones that reward ARP, Avatars for your account, or Battle Tokens. Towards the end of the month (around October 26), a store will open featuring rewards you can claim with your Battle Tokens, including game keys that cost 100 tokens each.
The current lineup includes more than 20 titles , including big-name releases like Death Loop , The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered , The Evil Within , Cassette Beasts , and RoboCop: Rogue City .
